metadata.title: Retro Synth-Pop Portrait with Shadow Play

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a man with dark, feathered hair looking off-camera, set against a vibrant pink background featuring a large, soft-edged silhouette of his own shadow. The composition is anchored by a three-tiered block of condensed, uppercase typography in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in the foreground vs. oversized shadow in the background
Warm skin tones vs. cool teal and grey typography
Sharp facial features vs. soft, diffused shadow edges
Dark clothing merging into the bottom frame vs. bright pink backdrop
coreInvariants: Subject looking away from the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the lower half; head is positioned mid-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, follows his gaze left, then moves across the pink space to the shadow, and finally up to the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant pink space in the upper center and right, occupied by the shadow and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black/brown of the subject's shirt and hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal and light blue for the lower text tiers
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with low-key, moody lighting on the subject.

treatment.fill: grey, teal, and light blue per line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color variation to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence.
Provides the clean, geometric, narrow structure.
Classic 80s choice for high-impact condensed text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with 80s feathered hair in a black shirt, looking left. The background is a flat magenta wall. A large, soft, dark silhouette of the man is projected onto the wall behind him to the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of right-aligned, extra-condensed uppercase text in the top right corner. Top line: dark grey. Middle line: teal. Bottom line: sky blue.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vibrant pink/magenta?
Is there a large, soft shadow silhouette?
Is the text right-aligned and extra-condensed?
Are there three distinct colors in the text block?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadow does not obscure the text.
Check that the subject's hair has a soft, feathered texture.
Verify the teal and blue text colors are distinct from the pink background.
Confirm the typography is perfectly right-aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a moody studio portrait with a large background shadow and a right-aligned block of condensed, multi-colored sans-serif type.
